big: Two clients sell gold on the same day. One sold a gold ETF held 14 months, the other physical gold held 14 months. Their tax is not the same. The holding period depends on the form.

lines: Is it 12 months for all gold?

No. Gold ETFs are long term after 12 months. Gold mutual funds and FoFs, and physical gold, are long term after 24 months. Long-term gains are taxed at 12.5% without indexation. Short-term gains on all are taxed at slab rate. Rates are as in the lesson, so confirm current rules.
